title: Esoteric and occult imagery on NRO mission patches

tellings.quote: Yeah, I looked into a lot of those patches actually which was really interesting. like they have these launch patches, these mission patches at NRO

plain: A YouTuber and UFO researcher named Chris Ramsay tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he looked closely at the mission patches made for launches by the NRO, the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites. He says he found them really interesting, pointing to occult and esoteric imagery on them, which he takes as a hint of hidden beliefs inside the agency.
